items.evidence: Master mix 106 water/40 buffer/4 dNTP/2 Q5 (19 uL per reaction); log shows 19 uL MM + 2.5 uL each primer + 1 uL template per well with the correct primer and template wells (e.g. A1/A2/A1 for fragment 1, D1 for fragment 7).

The PCR program is recorded in comments (98 C 30 s, 34 cycles, annealing 30 s, 72 C 5 min) with a pause, then 19 uL water, 5 uL rCutSmart and 1 uL DpnI per well, then a comment for 37 C 30 min and 65 C 20 min followed by a pause for column clean-up.
Log shows each assembly well A1-D1 receiving 7 uL water, 2 uL T4 buffer, fragments 3/2/3/2 uL from the correct PCR wells and 1 uL enzyme mix, totalling 20 uL.

Comments give a Golden Gate program (30x 37 C/16 C, 60 C 5 min, 4 C hold). They also give clean-up with a 10 uL elution, 5 uL into cells, 30 min on ice, 42 C for 60 s, 250 uL LB+dextrose, 37 C recovery for 60 min and plating on kanamycin LB agar, with pauses at the manual steps.
The transfer helper picks up a fresh tip for every transfer and drops it; the log shows a pick-up/drop pair around every action, with no cross-well aspirations through a shared tip.

judge.summary: The protocol covers the PCR setup, DpnI digestion, Golden Gate assembly and transformation, with the correct volumes, wells and tip handling in the log. The off-deck thermocycling, incubations and clean-ups are recorded as comments and pauses, as the task allows, so all five items pass.
